items.name: Commute.add_sq
items.type: {R : Type u} [Semiring R] {a b : R} (h : Commute a b) : (a + b) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 + 2 * a * b + b ^ 2

items.name: Commute.add_pow'
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {x y : R} (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) : (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.HasAntidiagonal.antidiagonal n, n.choose m.1 • (x ^ m.1 * y ^ m.2)

items.name: Commute.add_pow
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {x y : R} (h : Commute x y) (n : ℕ) : (x + y) ^ n = ∑ m ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), x ^ m * y ^ (n - m) * ↑(n.choose m)

items.name: add_pow_expChar_of_commute
items.type: {R : Type u_1} [Semiring R] {x y : R} (p : ℕ) [hR : ExpChar R p] (h : Commute x y) : (x + y) ^ p = x ^ p + y ^ p

items.name: add_pow_char_of_commute
